correctness.rationale: For each nonzero traceless square-zero X the entrywise valuation factorization X=π^s lift(Y) is unique. Primitive Y has Smith valuations (0,v), so image exponent 2ℓ-v; Cayley--Hamilton shows X²=0 exactly when 2ℓ-v≤m, with preserved image cardinality. Smooth nonzero roots of a²+bc over residue fields supply the counted coefficients; checkers exhaustively corroborate multiple mixed/equal-characteristic ring cases. Universal proof is algebraic, not experimental.

value.rationale: An explicit canonical rank-preserving correspondence between a nonlinear nilpotent-matrix zero-locus and a stratified primitive-matrix image-zeta enumeration over every finite chain ring is a structural link, not just coincident coefficients. It explains universal rank-fiber stability across ambient length and characteristic, and identifies individual source strata for each image size; no downstream conjecture is required.
